schema.title: Response Read My Review V1 Identity Me Review Get

post.description:
Send the identity images for team review (A09), or a correction back to the same review (A11).

Needs every image of the route already received (NIC: front, back and
selfie; passport: photo page and selfie) and the declaration (BR-011).
Sending again while the review is open returns the same review.

get.description:
W01: identity reviews in the caller's areas, oldest waiting first (FR-WEB-001, 002).
Open reviews unless states are given; mine=true for the caller's claimed reviews.

schema.title: Response List Reviews V1 Identity Reviews Get

get.description: The W01 counts: awaiting review, needs update, assigned to me (FR-WEB-001).
One review for W02: the member's details, which images exist and every decision so far.

post.description: Take the review (FR-WEB-003). While the caller holds it in review, they can open its evidence (PRM-03).
Give a claimed review back to the queue; its evidence closes for the caller.

Approve identity, request an update or record unable to verify (FR-WEB-008 to 011).

Only the reviewer holding the review decides. Approve needs every
checklist item and every required image opened by this reviewer.
Approval confirms identity only; membership is a separate decision (BR-014).

Appeal the latest Request-update or Unable-to-verify decision, once (M04, FR-IDV-013).

Someone other than the original reviewer decides. Until then the member
cannot submit again.

get.description: D05: appeals in the caller's areas, oldest first. Open appeals unless states are given.

schema.title: Response List Appeals V1 Identity Appeals Get

get.description: One appeal for D05: the member's statement, the decision under appeal and the image records.

post.description: Take the appeal. Never the original reviewer (PRM-29). While held, its evidence opens to the caller.

Uphold or overturn the decision, with a reason the member sees (FR-IDV-013). Final.

Overturning sends the review back to the queue for a fresh decision by
someone other than the original reviewer.

Report that a member may hold another account. Needs members.verify over the member's area.
Reporting a pair that already has a case returns that case.

get.description: D04: duplicate investigations in the caller's areas, oldest first. Open cases unless states are given.

schema.title: Response List Cases V1 Identity Duplicates Get

get.description: Both accounts side by side. Needs idv.duplicate.investigate over both accounts' areas.

post.description: Take the case. While held, both accounts' evidence opens to the caller (PRM-03).

Record whether the two accounts belong to one person, with a reason. Final, and it changes
neither account: inactivating one is a separate membership change (BR-015, BR-094).

Create an account with the NIC or passport route (A03, FR-AUTH-010 to 013).

Returns a session like sign-in. The identity is "Draft" and the
membership pending; nothing about the person is verified yet.
